about: v3 analytic set (written 5 Oct 2026, before any TOOLS result). expect_tasks: tools the route must include; expect_films: films the route must be about; expect_in_context: strings the tool context must contain; expect_spec: fields the aggregate spec must have; expect_honest: the answer must not invent what the context lacks.
